n63c3f9b9f3.headline: Finance tops Cyprus salary charts, agriculture lags behind
n63c3f9b9f3.summary: Cyprus average monthly earnings rose 7.3% in 2023, according to the Statistical Service. Finance and insurance roles averaged €4,493 a month, while agricultural workers averaged €924.
n63c3f9b9f3.why: Wage growth and sector pay gaps are relevant to inflation, consumer demand and labour costs in the Cypriot economy, a key financial centre.

n33404f730c.headline: SA, Nigeria to host a business roundtable
n33404f730c.summary: The South African government and Nigeria will host a business roundtable in Cape Town on Tuesday, SAnews reported. The event brings together the two countries' business and government interests.
n33404f730c.why: Bilateral business forums between large African economies can support trade and investment flows between the two countries.

n01df7b0c4c.headline: Lamda Development: 800-milion-euro loans for the malls construction in The Ellinikon
n01df7b0c4c.summary: Lamda Development has secured 800 million euros in loans to finance construction of two shopping centres at the former Ellinikon airport. The two malls are among the largest planned developments there.
n01df7b0c4c.why: Lamda Development is a Greek real estate developer, and the Ellinikon project is one of the largest urban redevelopments in Athens.

ne291f1967e.headline: The Richest Businessman in El Salvador and Key Man at Avianca Moves His Holding Company from Spain to Panama
ne291f1967e.summary: Roberto Kriete Ávila, the main shareholder of Avianca, has moved his holding company from Spain to Panama. He is described as the richest businessman in El Salvador.
ne291f1967e.why: Avianca is a Latin American airline group, and its shareholding structure is relevant to investors in the aviation sector.

nd1e325a912.headline: U.S. Dollar Falls Against Majors
nd1e325a912.summary: Sterling edged lower against a firm dollar on Thursday and gained slightly versus the euro in a quiet session due to a US holiday. The pound fell 0.1% to $1.26625.
nd1e325a912.why: Sterling is the British pound, and its exchange rate against the dollar affects UK trade, inflation and the returns of sterling-based investors.

n69175e34e0.headline: India markets: At least two brokerages cut Nifty targets, say headwinds yet to peak out
n69175e34e0.summary: The US dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday. It fell to nearly a 1-1/2-month low of 149.76 against the yen.
n69175e34e0.why: The yen is a major global currency, and dollar-yen moves affect Japanese exporters, carry trades and global currency markets.

n517c7365c4.headline: Estonia's economy contracted by 0.7% in Q3
n517c7365c4.summary: At least two brokerages cut their Nifty targets, saying headwinds have yet to peak. Foreign portfolio investors pulled out more than Rs 1 lakh crore from Indian equities in October and November.
n517c7365c4.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, and foreign portfolio flows are a key driver of Indian equity prices.

n5acaac222d.headline: Govt launches Digital Economy Policy to drive inclusive growth
n5acaac222d.summary: The Greek Ministry of Finance is expected to present a new tax bill on the Stock Exchange to the last cabinet meeting of November. The measure is designed to speed up procedures for regulating transactions in various assets.
n5acaac222d.why: Tax and regulatory changes to stock exchange transactions directly affect trading costs and investor behaviour on the Athens Stock Exchange.

n4dc7e797ed.headline: Milei Sets Sights on State After Stabilising Argentina
n4dc7e797ed.summary: The Ghanaian government has launched a Digital Economy Policy aimed at driving inclusive growth. The government says technology can bridge societal gaps and create opportunities.
n4dc7e797ed.why: Digital economy policies set the framework for telecoms, digital infrastructure and technology investment in an emerging market.

n0334eca4d3.headline: National Foods cites reduced benefits of public listing following VFEX exit plan
n0334eca4d3.summary: National Foods Holdings, Zimbabwe's largest food manufacturer, says its plan to delist from the Victoria Falls Stock Exchange reflects reduced benefits of a public listing.
n0334eca4d3.why: Delisting removes a company from public trading, reducing liquidity and disclosure for shareholders, and signals how firms weigh listing costs.

n02112a5a56.headline: ESM gives Greece the green light for early debt repayment
n02112a5a56.summary: The European Stability Mechanism approved early repayment to other creditors under Greece's ESM and EFSF loan agreements, with a proportional amount of the financial assistance involved.
n02112a5a56.why: The ESM is the eurozone's crisis lending fund, and early repayments reduce Greece's external debt burden and its refinancing risk.

nb47b9824a7.headline: NAMA Begins Collection Of Controversial $300 Helicopter Landing Fee
nb47b9824a7.summary: The Nigerian Airspace Management Agency will restart collection of a $300 landing fee on helicopter operators soon. The fee is described as controversial.
nb47b9824a7.why: Nigerian Airspace Management Agency regulates airspace and aviation charges, which affect operating costs for helicopter operators.

n5dd4d2c09b.headline: EEE: Profit after tax EUR 230 million for insurance companies in 2023
n5dd4d2c09b.summary: The 35 insurance undertakings active in Greece recorded aggregate profit after taxes of EUR 230 million in 2023, according to an association survey. Pre-tax profit totalled EUR 261 million.
n5dd4d2c09b.why: Insurers are large institutional investors, and their profitability reflects the health of Greece's financial sector.

nb14eba14a3.headline: Tethys Oil bidders have received regulatory approvals in Oman
nb14eba14a3.summary: Roc Oil Company, bidder for Tethys Oil, has received the necessary regulatory approvals in Oman for its recommended cash offer, according to a press release. The approvals relate to the Omani side of the offer.
nb14eba14a3.why: Tethys Oil is a Swedish-listed oil and gas company with assets in Oman, and takeover approvals determine whether a cash offer can complete.

nf4bd6ecf7e.headline: How Trump tariffs on Mexico could help kill Nissan
nf4bd6ecf7e.summary: Nissan's dire financial situation may get worse as US President Donald Trump could restrict Mexican imports, according to the report.
nf4bd6ecf7e.why: Nissan is a Japanese automaker with major vehicle production in Mexico, so trade barriers on Mexican-made cars directly affect its costs and sales.

n246989879f.headline: Australian Parliament bans social media for under-16s with world-first law
n246989879f.summary: A social media ban for children under 16 passed the Australian Parliament on Friday in a world-first law.
n246989879f.why: Age-restriction rules for social platforms affect user growth and advertising reach for major social media companies operating in Australia.

n3467baf7e7.headline: Mortgage costs could jump for 4.4m households by end of 2027 – Bank of England
n3467baf7e7.summary: The Bank of England said mortgage costs could jump for 4.4 million households by the end of 2027. It stressed that UK lenders remain in a strong position to support households and businesses.
n3467baf7e7.why: The Bank of England is the UK central bank, and its financial stability assessments shape expectations for mortgage lenders and household borrowing.

ne40261e105.headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Close with a drop of 0.74% for the General Index
ne40261e105.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange General Index closed at 1,393.49 points, down 0.74% on the day and 0.58% on the week. The index still rose 0.78% over November.
ne40261e105.why: The Athens General Index tracks the main listed Greek companies and is the benchmark for Greek equity performance.

ne37ae26082.headline: A vintage year for US stock markets that few people expected
ne37ae26082.summary: US equity investors had braced for a potentially turbulent 2024, including risks of a hard landing and late rate cuts. The year instead delivered a strong performance for US stock markets, according to the Business Times.
ne37ae26082.why: The S&P 500 is the main benchmark for US large-cap equities and reflects the broad performance of the US stock market.

n641b7a7025.headline: GDP per capita falls for sixth straight quarter, economists split on rate cut size
n641b7a7025.summary: The Canadian economy shrank on a per-person basis for a sixth consecutive quarter, extending a trend of high interest rates weighing on business investment and constraining growth. Economists are divided on the size of a possible rate cut.
n641b7a7025.why: Per-capita GDP measures economic output relative to population, and persistent declines signal weak living standards. The Bank of Canada's interest-rate path is a key driver of Canadian bond and currency markets.

n060bcf7aa9.headline: Tourism and private consumption boost Thailand’s economy: BOT
n060bcf7aa9.summary: The Bank of Thailand said tourism and private consumption are boosting the economy, with the government's cash handout scheme contributing to rising consumption.
n060bcf7aa9.why: The Bank of Thailand is the central bank that sets monetary policy and monitors growth, so its economic assessments inform views on Thai rates, the baht and local equities.

n9d9bdadac0.headline: Drivers still paying too much for fuel, watchdog warns
n9d9bdadac0.summary: Supermarket fuel margins rose from 7 in April to 8.1 in August, while non-supermarket fuel margins increased from 7.8 to 10.2 over the same period.
n9d9bdadac0.why: Retail fuel margins sit between wholesale fuel costs and pump prices, affecting UK motorists' costs, inflation and the competitive position of fuel retailers.

nadacee651d.headline: SenateTo Ease FX, Gas Supply Challenges In Power Sector
nadacee651d.summary: The Senate is working on plans to improve access to foreign exchange and ensure uninterrupted gas supply to the power sector. The measures target supply constraints in Nigeria's electricity industry.
nadacee651d.why: Foreign exchange availability and gas supply determine whether power generators can operate and whether investors can repatriate funds in Nigeria.

n1ee67f4311.headline: Vietnam c.bank raises caps on credit growth for commercial banks; ensuring sufficient funding for economic growth
n1ee67f4311.summary: Vietnam's central bank raised the caps on credit growth for commercial banks for this year. The move is intended to ensure sufficient funding for economic growth.
n1ee67f4311.why: Credit growth limits set by the State Bank of Vietnam shape lending capacity of the country's commercial banks.

necffc913f4.headline: Rosan: Prabowo’s $18.5 Billion Investment Deals Will Drive Regional Growth
necffc913f4.summary: President Prabowo Subianto's first overseas trip produced investment commitments totalling $18.5 billion. Indonesia's minister Rosan said the deals will drive regional growth.
necffc913f4.why: Foreign investment commitments influence Indonesia's growth outlook, the rupiah and the sectors that receive the capital.

ne15e44d963.headline: Ireland headed for coalition government following parliamentary election, exit poll suggests
ne15e44d963.summary: An exit poll suggests Ireland's three biggest parties won roughly equal shares, pointing to another coalition government after the general election.
ne15e44d963.why: Government formation determines fiscal and policy direction in Ireland, a euro-area economy with a large multinational corporate base.

nb93bd9884a.headline: Sinn Fein tops Irish exit poll but unlikely to win govt
nb93bd9884a.summary: An exit poll put Sinn Fein in the lead at Ireland's general election, though its rivals may still prevent it from forming a government.
nb93bd9884a.why: Government formation in Ireland determines fiscal, tax and EU-facing economic policy, which matter for investors in Irish assets and corporate tax-sensitive companies.

nd3f217e980.headline: Three main parties in tight race, according to Irish General Election exit poll
nd3f217e980.summary: An Irish general election exit poll shows Sinn Fein at 21.1, Fine Gael at 21 and Fianna Fail at 19.5 in first-preference votes. The three parties are virtually tied.
nd3f217e980.why: Ireland's government formation determines fiscal and corporate tax policy, which matters for investors in Irish-based multinationals.

n4634aff57d.headline: Fiscal deficit at 46.5 pc of full-year target at Oct-end Govt data
n4634aff57d.summary: India's fiscal deficit stood at 46.5% of the full-year target at the end of October, according to government data.
n4634aff57d.why: The fiscal deficit measures the gap between government spending and revenue, and it shapes bond supply, sovereign borrowing and rating assessments.

neaed3b1378.headline: 'Not robots': Woolies says no shortages as staff strike
neaed3b1378.summary: About 1,500 Woolworths warehouse workers are on strike, but the supermarket giant says their absence is not leading to shortages on shelves.
neaed3b1378.why: Woolworths is one of Australia's largest supermarket chains, and warehouse labour disruption can affect stock availability and costs.

n464d238671.headline: Marlborough Wine to delist from NZX in cost-cutting push
n464d238671.summary: NZX-listed winemaker Marlborough Wine Estates will delist from the exchange to reduce costs. It reported an 11% drop in revenue for the year ended June 30.
n464d238671.why: Delisting removes a small listed company from public markets, usually to cut the ongoing costs of listing and compliance.

sources.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n9577da46e6.headline: Australia's Albanese shifts to election mode, seeking trust on living costs
n9577da46e6.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has pivoted to election mode, seeking to win back voter confidence that his government can tackle high living costs, particularly housing.
n9577da46e6.why: Cost of living and housing affordability shape Australian fiscal policy, interest rate expectations and consumer spending.

n57abbe6a06.headline: Need to simplify GST and reduce cess Ex CEA Subramanian
n57abbe6a06.summary: Former Chief Economic Adviser Subramanian said GST needs to be simplified and cess reduced, according to a PTI report.
n57abbe6a06.why: The Goods and Services Tax is India's main indirect tax, and changes to its rate structure affect consumer prices, corporate costs and government revenue.

n8ccdf9e0a4.headline: Price-conscious Aussies spend up on record Black Friday
n8ccdf9e0a4.summary: Cost-of-living pressures are driving more Australians to sales, delivering a bonanza for retailers during Black Friday. The report did not give sales totals.
n8ccdf9e0a4.why: Black Friday spending is a key indicator of consumer demand in retail, which drives retailer earnings and the broader consumer economy.

ndd2d7d49d0.headline: Incuspaze seeks $25M funding to expand flexible office spaces across India
ndd2d7d49d0.summary: Coworking operator Incuspaze is seeking $25 million in fresh funding to expand across India's major business hubs. It plans to add 2 million square feet of space by December 2025.
ndd2d7d49d0.why: Flexible office operators lease space to companies on short terms, and their growth reflects demand for commercial real estate.

n494f0c076d.headline: SC pulls up HDFC bank over ‘homebuyer harassment’
n494f0c076d.summary: India's Supreme Court sharply criticised HDFC Bank over a homebuyer being harassed and suggested bank officials be investigated if they colluded with builders.
n494f0c076d.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, so court scrutiny of its conduct can affect its reputation, compliance costs and regulatory risk.

n92d6357e09.headline: Sensex rebounds 759 pts Nifty ends above 24 100 on gains in Airtel RIL
n92d6357e09.summary: The Sensex rebounded 759 points and the Nifty ended above 24,100. Gains in Bharti Airtel and Reliance Industries led the rebound.
n92d6357e09.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indexes of India's stock market, tracking large listed companies across sectors.
n92d6357e09.why_moved: Gains in heavyweight stocks Bharti Airtel and Reliance Industries lifted the benchmark indexes after a rebound in the session.

na4518818ce.headline: DAP fertilizer availability at 34L tonnes exceeds 31.6L tonnes demand from Oct 1 to Nov 24
na4518818ce.summary: DAP fertiliser availability in India reached 34 lakh tonnes, exceeding demand of 31.6 lakh tonnes from October 1 to November 24. The data points to adequate supply during the kharif-to-rabi transition.
na4518818ce.why: Di-ammonium phosphate (DAP) is a key phosphate fertiliser used in Indian agriculture. Supply and demand balances affect farm input costs and the government's fertiliser subsidy spending.

nbe9618e0e5.headline: In the news today: Liberals, NDP pass GST bill in House of Commons
nbe9618e0e5.summary: Liberal and NDP MPs passed a GST bill in the House of Commons, according to a Canadian Press roundup of the day's news.
nbe9618e0e5.why: The Goods and Services Tax is a federal consumption tax in Canada. Changes to it affect consumer prices, government revenue and household budgets.

nca551ad4c2.headline: BOK unexpectedly cuts key rate to 3%
nca551ad4c2.summary: The Bank of Korea lowered its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.0% on Thursday, a surprise move. The cut was unexpected by many observers.
nca551ad4c2.why: The Bank of Korea sets the benchmark policy rate for South Korea, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields and the won. Its decisions are closely watched by Asian investors.
nca551ad4c2.why_moved: The rate cut was described as unexpected, which can shift expectations for monetary policy and bond yields.

n7b7958d348.headline: One-off property tax rebate in 2025 for owner-occupiers to soften cost-of-living pains
n7b7958d348.summary: Owner-occupied HDB flats will get a 20% property tax rebate, and owner-occupied private residential properties a 15% rebate capped at S$1,000, in 2025.
n7b7958d348.why: Property tax rebates are fiscal measures that affect household costs and the housing market, which matters for property and banking investors.

ne9f584326f.headline: Brussels vets countries' compliance with EU fiscal rules
ne9f584326f.summary: The European Commission assessed the multiannual spending plans of 21 member states, giving passing grades to 20 and failing one under the EU fiscal rules.
ne9f584326f.why: EU fiscal rules govern government deficits and debt across the bloc, influencing borrowing costs and the economic policy outlook for member states.

nf8bdfe0cd5.headline: November 29: Share market opens in green, media and pharma stocks shine
nf8bdfe0cd5.summary: The Indian stock market opened higher on Friday as buying was seen in the media and pharma sectors in early trade.
nf8bdfe0cd5.why: India's benchmark indices, including the BSE Sensex, track the country's largest listed companies and reflect domestic investor sentiment.

n5160843a15.headline: Yen surges to 150 per dollar amid growing BOJ rate hike bets
n5160843a15.summary: The yen rose as much as 1% to a six-week high of 150 per dollar on Friday after faster-than-expected developments. Traders increased bets on a Bank of Japan rate hike.
n5160843a15.why: The Bank of Japan sets interest rates for the world's third-largest economy, and its policy shifts drive yen moves, carry trades and global bond yields.
n5160843a15.why_moved: Faster-than-expected developments increased market bets on Bank of Japan rate hikes, which typically support the yen by raising Japanese yield expectations.

n22bacdf688.headline: ESF: No, the Germans say rescue France in case of bankruptcy
n22bacdf688.summary: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said the ECB will not intervene in government bond markets over political risks. He was asked about France's borrowing costs amid uncertainty over next year's budget.
n22bacdf688.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its stance on bond-market support shapes sovereign borrowing costs across the bloc.

n1eae109b6c.headline: Yen bulls charge ahead after Tokyo inflation data
n1eae109b6c.summary: Hotter-than-expected Tokyo CPI readings boosted yen bulls in a quiet post-Thanksgiving Asian session. The day-ahead note covers European and global markets.
n1eae109b6c.why: The yen is a major funding and safe-haven currency, and Tokyo CPI is a leading indicator of Japan's national inflation, which shapes Bank of Japan policy expectations.
n1eae109b6c.why_moved: Hotter-than-expected Tokyo CPI readings encouraged yen buyers, per the market note.

n2e228ac519.headline: Ministry Reveals Cost Components to Lower Airfares
n2e228ac519.summary: The government plans to reduce domestic flight ticket prices by up to 10 percent during the Christmas and New Year period of 2024-2025, and the ministry has revealed the cost components involved.
n2e228ac519.why: Airfare policy affects airline revenues and the travel and tourism sector, and it can feed into consumer spending and inflation.

n01b896d546.headline: MUFG offers to buy WealthNavi for 99.7b yen in fintech push
n01b896d546.summary: Japan's biggest bank, MUFG, is seeking to buy robo-adviser WealthNavi through a tender offer at 1,950 yen a share. It would make WealthNavi a wholly owned unit.
n01b896d546.why: MUFG is Japan's largest bank by assets, and it is expanding into fintech through acquisitions such as this one.

n5ec2bf12bb.headline: Retailers seize on Trump tariff fears and urge shoppers to buy now
n5ec2bf12bb.summary: Retailers are encouraging shoppers to buy now ahead of possible tariffs, after the president-elect threatened further tariffs on major US trading partners.
n5ec2bf12bb.why: Retailers sell imported goods, so tariffs can raise their costs and shift consumer spending patterns.

n3d5b72bb8f.headline: RBA reforms raise uncertainties over rate path, economists say
n3d5b72bb8f.summary: Australia passed legislation late at night to split the Reserve Bank of Australia's board into two entities. Economists say the change may pave the way for published votes and adds uncertainty over the rate path.
n3d5b72bb8f.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bond yields.

n591b13d416.headline: Why There Is Growth Ln GDP, Reduction Ln Unemployment - Statistician General
n591b13d416.summary: Nigeria's Statistician-General Prince Adeyemi Adeniran attributed GDP growth and reduced unemployment to economic developments. The remarks were made by the head of the National Bureau of Statistics.
n591b13d416.why: GDP and unemployment statistics from Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics guide investor views on Africa's largest economy.

n5f171ffe9e.headline: Dominican Republic on Track to Meet 25% Renewable Energy Goal
n5f171ffe9e.summary: The Dominican Republic has installed 1,200 megawatts of renewable energy capacity and is on track to meet its 25% renewable energy target this year.
n5f171ffe9e.why: Renewable energy expansion reduces fossil fuel dependence and supports sustainable economic growth in the Dominican Republic.

n07952f5764.summary: Mihály Varga accepted the nomination to become president of the Hungarian National Bank, aiming to serve Hungary's stability and growth.
n07952f5764.why: The central bank president influences monetary policy and economic stability in Hungary.

n9fd169b415.why: Political stability and security issues can affect economic confidence, investment climate, and foreign relations.

nbf6f6f3a4d.headline: Indian stock market: 5 key things that changed for market overnight- Gift Nifty, Nikkei Index to stronger Yen | Stock Market News
nbf6f6f3a4d.summary: India’s stock market opened cautiously, with GIFT Nifty declining and weak global cues affecting investor sentiment.
nbf6f6f3a4d.why: Market performance reflects investor confidence and global economic conditions impacting Indian equities.

n596b9a9135.headline: Consortium aims to seal ESR buyout at more than US$7b: sources
n596b9a9135.summary: A consortium including ESR’s founders and Qatar Investment Authority aims to complete a buyout valued above US$7 billion.
n596b9a9135.why: The buyout impacts real estate investment trusts and regional property markets, influencing investor exposure to Asia-Pacific assets.

n04090f4412.headline: Syed Atta appointed ETPB chief
n04090f4412.summary: Syed Atta-ur-Rehman has been assigned as Chairman of the Evacuee Trust Property Board in Islamabad.
n04090f4412.why: Leadership changes in government agencies can influence policy implementation and asset management in Pakistan.

neabcde5b8f.headline: Global markets in flux: Japan
neabcde5b8f.summary: Asian shares declined while the yen aimed for its best week in four months, amid strong inflation data and potential BOJ rate hike.
neabcde5b8f.why: Inflation and monetary policy expectations influence Japanese equities, currency, and bond markets.

necec30e673.headline: Supreme Consolidated makes strong debut on ACE Market
necec30e673.summary: Supreme Consolidated Resources Bhd transferred to ACE Market and surged 48% on its trading debut.
necec30e673.why: This IPO's performance reflects investor confidence and market sentiment in Malaysia's equity market.

nd3a7f68909.headline: Slowdown concerns! Q2 GDP slips to 2-year low at 5.4%
nd3a7f68909.summary: India's GDP growth for the second quarter slowed to 5.4%, marking a two-year low, though it remains higher than China's 4.6% growth in the same period.
nd3a7f68909.why: GDP growth rates are key indicators of economic health; India's growth slowdown impacts investor confidence and policy decisions amid global economic uncertainties.
nd3a7f68909.why_moved: The slower GDP growth raised concerns about economic momentum, influencing market sentiment and policy expectations.

nad40db1c6d.headline: India and UK Forge Strategic Partnership for Electric Propulsion Systems in Indian Navy
nad40db1c6d.summary: India and the UK agreed on a strategic partnership to develop electric propulsion systems for the Indian Navy during a meeting in Portsmouth, UK.
nad40db1c6d.why: This partnership enhances defense technology collaboration and supports India's naval modernization efforts with potential economic and industrial benefits.

nd52da666e4.headline: US bribery case: CRISIL reaffirms strong credit ratings for Adani Group, says co has strong liquidity, cash flows to meet debt obligations
nd52da666e4.summary: CRISIL confirmed strong credit ratings for Adani Group, citing strong liquidity and cash flows, with no negative lender actions following US bribery allegations.
nd52da666e4.why: Adani Group is a major Indian conglomerate; credit ratings affect its borrowing costs and investor confidence amid legal scrutiny.

n19f3c01cc5.headline: WE WILL START THE MORNING LIGHTLY American elections disrupt the coffee market HIGHEST PRICE SINCE 1977
n19f3c01cc5.summary: Coffee prices reached their highest level since 1977, with Brazil, the world's largest producer, hit by extreme drought this year.
n19f3c01cc5.why: Brazil supplies a large share of global coffee, so its crop conditions strongly influence world coffee prices and food companies' input costs.
n19f3c01cc5.why_moved: Extreme drought in Brazil, the largest coffee producer, has tightened supply and pushed prices to their highest since 1977.

ncefbcfa37c.summary: Serbia's unemployment rate stood at 8.1% in the third quarter, with the employment rate at a record 51.9%, Finance Minister Siniša Mali said.
ncefbcfa37c.why: Labour-market data signals the health of an economy and influences fiscal and monetary policy expectations.

n8be4a9475b.headline: Lázár's team wants to have the major railway stations renovated as rental properties
n8be4a9475b.summary: The ministry and state railway MÁV are seeking tenants for major railway stations who would renovate them in exchange for living there rent-free.
n8be4a9475b.why: MÁV is Hungary's state rail operator, and its property decisions affect public assets and urban real estate.

nf0f52f7c31.headline: Westing: BBU sample verification, transformation expected to bear fruit by 2025 - Liberty Finance
nf0f52f7c31.summary: Westing, a lithium battery manufacturer, is shifting focus to electric vehicle batteries and backup power systems, with expected results by 2025.
nf0f52f7c31.why: The company's transition aligns with the growing demand for electric vehicle and renewable energy storage solutions.

nf0f52f7c31.original_headline: 西勝：BBU送樣客戶驗證 轉型盼2025年開花結果 - 自由財經
